## Symbolic stage by component (split build, medians over repetitions)

The split build clocks every reducer lookup and unfuses multiplication from interning (products into a scratch buffer, then interned). That changes the stage itself: its symbolic total differs from the timed build's (last column; the A/B below), so shares are of the split build's own total. "Other" is the remainder: building reducer rows (lead division, signature multiply) and the row vectors. Frequency: the symbolic thread's CPU, `scaling_cur_freq` before and after each batch, time-weighted; the CPU set's sampled mean over the whole child is beside it.
